description: Enable/activate a sequence so it starts processing its triggers. Sequences are created disabled so their content can be reviewed before activation; this tool is intended for user-requested activation. simulate_sequence shows who currently matches and whether the sequence is ready. Activation does not enroll existing matches unless audienceAutoEnroll is saved. Relay any response `warnings` to the user, such as a contact_added trigger with no list, which enrolls every new contact.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: enable_sequence

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `enable_sequence` MCP tool.

acceptsNewEnrollments.description: Whether new subscribers can enter the sequence right now.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

effectiveStatus.description: Resolved run state. The one field to branch on: `status` still reads `active` while new enrollments are paused.

effectiveStatusSummary.description: One plain-language sentence describing the run state, safe to show a user verbatim.

enrollmentPaused.description: Whether new sequence enrollments are paused.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

processesExistingEnrollments.description: Whether subscribers already inside the sequence keep advancing and receiving steps.

status.description: Stored lifecycle status after the change.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
